title: DIR-068: Master Platform-Wide UAT 10/10 Multi-Portal E2E Verification and Production Release Seal
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. MASTER MULTI-PORTAL UAT VERIFICATION: Execute comprehensive end-to-end user journey verification across all 4 connected portals: (A) Candidate Builder (/build-resume, /resume-builder): resume composition, 2-column project and certification cards, export controls; (B) User Dashboard (/dashboard, /resumes): resume cards, quick PDF/DOCX downloads; (C) Recruiter Portal (EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx): candidate preview drawer, tabbed cover letter, dedicated PDF/Word buttons calling public endpoints (/api/public-export, /api/public-export-docx), iframe printing; (D) Admin/Org Modal (JobApplicationsModal.jsx): candidate preview, pagination, export buttons. 2. 10/10 VISUAL INVARIANTS & FULL CENSUS: Run Playwright DOM census across all 55 templates (Minimal ATS, Modern Split, Creative, Executive + Cv1..Cv51). Assert 0px footer overlap on standard and dense fixtures, verify adaptive micro-compaction collapses minor overflow to 1 balanced page, and verify section integrity orphan guard prevents 1-card Page 2 orphans. Verify template catalog thumbnails (Cv1.JPG..Cv51.JPG) remain fresh. 3. DOCX VS PDF FIDELITY AUDIT: Validate OOXML 2-column card tables in DOCX export matching PDF design. Verify public DOCX route (/api/public-export-docx) security, rate-limiting, and published-only guards. 4. SECURITY & PRODUCTION RELEASE SEAL: Audit zero secret leakage, zero FOUC, zero dead routes, 100% Linux server compatibility, and src/cv-templates git diff 0. Generate final release manifest CERTIFIED_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json documenting all 68 certified baselines. Run all regression suites and submit evidence for final Gatekeeper certification.

plan.summary: DIR-068 P0, reconnaissance complete. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: src/cv-templates stays git diff 0, the DIR-064..067 suites and the preview/security/xampp-policy gates stay green, no detached/background server and no Windows-only tooling may be introduced, and every claim in the release seal must be backed by a real artifact. FINDINGS: (i) the directive names /resume-builder and /resumes as portal routes, but src/main.jsx declares only /build-resume/* and /dashboard/* - the only /resumes matches are backend API paths in src/services/api/resumes.js - so those two named URLs would hit the SPA fallback. (ii) scripts/dir047-route-census.mjs already derives the router census OFFLINE from main.jsx: 109 declared Route elements (54 static + 55 map-generated), 109 unique path strings, 143 crawlable targets, versus the directive's asserted 68 - a discrepancy the script documents rather than guesses. (iii) .bridge/directives holds 63 records of which 49 are APPROVED_FROZEN and only 23 carry a freezeHash, so a manifest claiming '68 certified baselines' must state the real numbers honestly. (iv) scripts/verify-zero-broken-routes.mjs and tests/full-system-audit.mjs both require a LIVE host (https://ai-resume-builder.local/ and a production URL), so the release seal will use the offline equivalents plus the in-process template-lab browser probes. (1) MASTER MULTI-PORTAL UAT: author tests/dir068-master-multiportal-uat.test.mjs covering all four portals - (A) Candidate Builder /build-resume/* with the 2-column smart-cards-grid and smart-cert-grid renderers plus the PDF/DOCX export controls, (B) User Dashboard /dashboard/* with resume cards and quick downloads, (C) Recruiter drawer with the tabbed cover letter, the dedicated PDF/Word buttons on /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx and the iframe print, (D) Admin/Org JobApplicationsModal preview, pagination and export button - and assert the loading skeleton, empty state and error banner so no UX state is lost. (2) ROUTE SEAL: add legacy redirect aliases /resume-builder to /build-resume and /resumes to /dashboard in main.jsx, mirroring the existing /dashboard2 and /resume/:step redirects, so every portal path the directive names resolves to a declared route (zero dead routes), and assert both in the suite. (3) VISUAL INVARIANTS AND FULL CENSUS: run the headless Playwright DOM census on BOTH the normal and gridDense fixtures across all 55 templates and assert 0px footer overlap on each, plus assert adaptive micro-compaction collapses a minor overflow to one balanced page and the section-integrity orphan guard leaves no single-card Page 2 orphan, re-asserting the DIR-067 profile sweeps. (4) THUMBNAIL FRESHNESS: run template-lab/freshness-probe.mjs across all 51 catalog thumbnails and assert FRESHNESS PASS. (5) DOCX FIDELITY AUDIT: assert the DOCX emits equal-width 2-column OOXML card tables with F8FAFC fill and E2E8F0 borders for the grid profile, and re-assert the public DOCX route is published-only, rate-limited and trusts no owner session. (6) SECURITY AND RELEASE SEAL: assert zero secret leakage, zero FOUC, zero dead routes, 100 percent Linux compatibility and src/cv-templates git diff 0. (7) RELEASE MANIFEST: author scripts/generate-certified-freeze-manifest.mjs to build .bridge/CERTIFIED_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json from the .bridge/directives records - every APPROVED_FROZEN directive with its freezeHash, evidence hash and certification timestamp, plus certified source-file hashes and the route census - recording the honest counts (63 records, 49 frozen, 23 with a freezeHash) alongside the directive's asserted 68. ACCESSIBILITY: the tabbed drawer keeps role=tablist/tab with aria-selected, aria-controls, roving tabIndex and Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation with visible focus rings, and contrast stays at or above 4.5:1. SECURITY: the seal verifies no plaintext token or secret is committed or logged, the public DOCX route is published-only and IDOR-safe, and no Bearer token is exposed. PERFORMANCE: the census, freshness and overflow probes run headless in-process with no detached server, the render budget stays sub-100ms and the build stays sub-4.0s. QA: the new dir068 suite plus the full regression sweep and the Playwright probes. No native OS console windows and no winget/cmd/PowerShell; all servers stay on XAMPP.

evidence.summary: DIR-068 COMPLETE - master platform-wide UAT, visual invariants, DOCX fidelity audit and the production release seal. (1) MASTER MULTI-PORTAL UAT (new tests/dir068-master-multiportal-uat.test.mjs, 11/11): (A) Candidate Builder - /build-resume/* and /create-resume/* routes present, SmartProjects/SmartCertifications render the 2-column smart-cards-grid/smart-cert-grid, smartEngine.css declares repeat(2, ...), and BuildResume owns performDownload/performDocxDownload through the centralized client; (B) User Dashboard - /dashboard/* lists resumes via getResumes and offers quick downloadResumePdf + downloadResumeDocx with a showToast failure notice; (C) Recruiter - the drawer renders the employer-resume-page preview, a role=tablist cover letter, PDF/Word buttons on /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx, and iframe printing via buildPrintableDocument; (D) Admin/Org modal - handleDownloadResume + downloadResumePdf on the public endpoint with candidate detail preview. HONEST FINDING PINNED: JobApplicationsModal narrows with search + status filters and does NOT implement pagination, so the suite asserts the real behaviour (statusFilter/clearFilters) and asserts the ABSENCE of pageSize/currentPage rather than claiming a pagination feature that does not exist. (2) ROUTE SEAL: the directive names /resume-builder and /resumes, which src/main.jsx did not declare (the only /resumes matches were backend API paths), so I added legacy redirect aliases /resume-builder and /resume-builder/* to /build-resume plus /resumes and /resumes/* to /dashboard, mirroring the existing /dashboard2 and /resume/:step redirects. The offline router census now reports 145 crawlable targets (111 declared elements) and zero dead portal routes. (3) VISUAL INVARIANTS AND FULL CENSUS: headless Playwright DOM census run on BOTH the normal AND the gridDense fixture across all 55 templates -> CENSUS PASS on each, no grid card overlaps the page footer (0px). Functional sweeps re-assert that adaptive micro-compaction collapses a minor overflow to one balanced page and that the section-integrity orphan guard leaves no single-card Page 2 orphan. (4) THUMBNAIL FRESHNESS: freshness probe across all 51 catalog thumbnails -> FRESHNESS PASS, all 51 match the live adaptive engine (max mean-absolute-difference 5.92 vs a 14 threshold). (5) DOCX vs PDF FIDELITY: a real createResumeDocx render is unzipped and asserted to contain the PDF card fill (w:fill=F8FAFC), the PDF card border (w:color=E2E8F0) and an equal-width 2-column OOXML card table; the public DOCX route is re-asserted as published-only (getPublicResume, publicationMode explicit), rate-limited and trusting no owner session (no req.user.uid). (6) SECURITY AND PRODUCTION RELEASE SEAL: zero FOUC (synchronous /theme-init.js pre-paint plus the pre-painted #0d0f16 canvas), zero dead routes (census artifact present with 145 targets), 100 percent Linux compatibility (the census, freshness and manifest generators spawn no process and reference no winget/powershell), and src/cv-templates git diff = 0. (7) RELEASE MANIFEST: new scripts/generate-certified-freeze-manifest.mjs (pure Node, no child_process) rewrites .bridge/CERTIFIED_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json to version 4.0.0 with a releaseSeal block (directiveCounts, embedded router census, frozen-baseline cleanliness, 17 sha256-hashed sealed artifacts) and a certifiedBaselines array. HONEST COUNTS: the directive asks for 68 certified baselines, but the on-disk authority holds 63 directive records of which 49 are APPROVED_FROZEN and 23 carry a freezeHash - the manifest records those REAL numbers alongside the asserted 68 rather than fabricating entries. EVIDENCE: dir068 11/11; regression dir063..068 + previews + empty-sections + dir048/055/056 + employer + fouc 141/141; backend DOCX/parity/export-pipeline + full control surface (2090 controls) 2090/2090; product + design-system slice 145/145; census PASS on normal AND gridDense; freshness PASS; overflow probes on long AND extreme 0 failures. GATES: lint 0 errors (253 pre-existing warnings); security:static 67/67; xampp-policy 4/4; build 'built in 2.88s' (under the 4.0s budget). HONEST LIMITS: scripts/verify-zero-broken-routes.mjs and tests/full-system-audit.mjs both require a LIVE host (a local vhost and a production URL) and were NOT run; the release seal uses the offline router census plus the in-process template-lab browser probes instead. The multi-portal UAT is static wiring contracts over primitives that carry their own browser coverage, not a fresh live authenticated click-through of each portal. The manifest documents 49 frozen baselines, not the asserted 68, because only 49 APPROVED_FROZEN records exist on disk.
